items.title: 52157_Count Basie oral history interview
items.q: And he only came over to fill in for this kid that got hurt in Chicago and when he got over here... as far as I'm concerned, he's the guy I was looking for.

ctx.x: Because Sammy used to introduce her.

items.title: 52157_Count Basie oral history interview
items.q: I first saw him down in -- first time I saw him was down in Memphis... I knew he had to be with me.

ctx.x: It was just so beautiful because it was a gorgeous engagement; the kids up there just loved her, you know? And it's a strange thing, it was almost a -- Ella was on one stand and we was on Chick, you know, Chick Webb. (Inaudible) the other. I mean, (inaudible) But and then we played the Apollo Theater. That's what really -- that's really where she really did shine. I never would forget that. That was beautiful (inaudible). I mean, she just couldn't get off the stage there.
